reason: B more directly targets high-temperature aggressive service with a metallurgically bonded HEA coating, specifies relevant conditions and measurements, and is supported by evidence for laser-clad HEAs in molten salts and wear. A is comparatively vague and relies on an ultrathin brittle oxide nanolaminate whose adhesion and survival under thermal cycling and particulate impact are doubtful, while its >10 nm and >20% thresholds are unsupported.
